subject.title: fix(commands): bound reset-hook transcript reads to prevent OOM

question: Should command `before_reset` hooks preserve messages for transcripts over 16 MiB through the existing transcript reader, or may this PR intentionally send `messages: []` for oversized transcripts?
rationale: The patch improves memory safety but changes a plugin-visible hook payload contract, and CI cannot decide whether that compatibility tradeoff is acceptable.

options.title: Preserve payloads through the reader
options.body: Revise the command reset-hook path to use the existing transcript reader/index with archive fallback so large valid transcripts remain visible to plugins without whole-file buffering.

options.title: Accept the empty-payload cap
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally accept `messages: []` for oversized transcripts if that plugin behavior is documented and proven with reset-hook path evidence.

options.title: Pause for broader transcript policy
options.body: Hold the PR if oversized transcript behavior should be decided across reset hooks, session memory, and history readers together.

recommendation.title: Preserve payloads through the reader
recommendation.body: Revise the command reset-hook path to use the existing transcript reader/index with archive fallback so large valid transcripts remain visible to plugins without whole-file buffering.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history signal for the command reset-hook module boundary and recent nearby maintenance.
